_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Mixing up short and long vowels

items.native: A big boat on the sea.

segments.text: Ship, Sheep, Sit, Seat. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Ship, Sheep, Sit, Seat.

native.caption: Can you hear the difference between “ship” and “sheep”, or “sit” and “seat”? For the long sound, spread your lips; for the short sound, relax them. Watch Carlos’s mouth, then say each word in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
